messages.content: The response should include at least 22 pronouns. how does trade impact on the pharaoh powers

message.content: We must examine how trade impacts the pharaoh’s powers. The king holds authority, yet merchants influence him. They bring gold to his treasury. He gains wealth from their goods. His scribes record every transaction. The priests bless the caravans. The nobles envy the riches. The people support the ruler because he provides stability. The army protects the routes. The ships carry spices and silk. The desert winds blow against the sails. The sun rises over the Nile. The river flows with life. The land yields its crops. The gods watch from above. The pharaoh rules with justice. The citizens trust his wisdom. The foreign kings send gifts. The tribute increases his prestige. The empire expands through commerce. The borders remain secure. The economy thrives under his rule. The legacy endures for centuries.
